notes: Asset paths are relative to docs/agent-hub/design. Temporary Figma download URLs are never runtime paths. Reused original files are unchanged; only one whole native16 up SVG and one reference-only gradient PNG are added.

Effective visibility includes hidden ancestors. Hidden back arrow, error/info, resize, schedule row helpers, footer plus slots, filter branch and dot helpers are excluded; stored fill/stroke fields without a visible paint do not create a rendered glyph.

All15 card rows are measured scroll content. Their glyph/image nodes are visible in the Figma tree even when clipped outside the current viewport; this is not proof that every row appears simultaneously or that scrolling is implemented.
Form model chevron FRAME matches existing Picker whole16 SVG by exact shape/stroke/paint; no component source identity is inferred.
Main archive full pin16 is reused. The supplied narrow GROUP fragment is provenance only; rotation and clip already exist in the whole16 SVG.
Qwen and tool images are dynamic sample data. Original file SHA1 matches each Figma ImagePaint.imageHash; aspect ratios, actual FILL and unchanged filters are recorded per callsite.
Finder content-fade is gradient paint; its supplied PNG is a reference export with different native bounds, not original uploaded image content.
The actual recent-section delay20 glyph is present and matches the existing asset byte-for-byte despite an empty glyph div in generated context.
Consuming source/export and runtime dialog behavior are not verified. This source snapshot does not force shared frontend dependencies or change other solutions.
